title: Verify Administrator can delete a customer payment
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Invoicing & Payments: Delete).
At least one customer payment has been recorded.
steps:
1. Click Customers in the main navigation and open a customer that has a recorded payment.
2. Open the Payments tab on the customer.
3. Click Delete on a payment and confirm.
expected: The payment is deleted and removed from the Payments tab without a permission error.
